name: Joan Miró at Serralves
description: Explore the fascinating dialogue between Joan Miró and contemporary artists in "Elective Affinities," a must-see at Porto's premier modern art museum.
longDescription:
"Elective Affinities" at the Serralves Museum presents an exhibition dedicated to the work of Joan Miró, exploring his artistic legacy through a dialogue with contemporary artists. The curatorial approach focuses on the connections and influences between Miró's surrealist and abstract expressions and the practices of artists working today. This exhibition is housed within one of Porto's prominent institutions for modern and contemporary art.

Visitors to Serralves can expect to view a collection of Miró's works alongside pieces by various contemporary artists. The exhibition is situated within the museum's galleries, offering a focused viewing experience of the artworks. The Serralves Museum is known for its modernist architecture and extensive parkland, providing a distinct setting for art appreciation.

The exhibition runs from June 11 to June 17, 2026. Tickets are priced at €20. The Serralves Museum is accessible by bus, with several lines stopping near the entrance.
